data.one_liner: Extension method to translate iOS utsname machine codes into full product names.
data.what_it_does: Provides an extension method on iOS utsname machine strings to translate device identifiers like 'iPhone7,1' into readable product names like 'iPhone 6 Plus'. It relies on a maintained list of iOS device identifiers.
use_when: You are displaying iOS device info to users and want friendly product names instead of raw machine codes.
You are using the device_info package and need readable iOS model names.
avoid_when: You do not need to display or log iOS device model names.
You are building apps strictly for non-iOS platforms.
strengths: Regularly updated with new iOS device models.
weaknesses: Limited scope dedicated solely to iOS device name translation.
